hero.headline: Growing Native Trees. Creating Lush Gardens. Restoring Green India.
hero.subtitle: We plant native forests in villages and design beautiful green spaces & gardens for apartments, offices, and homes.

programs.title: Village Tree Plantation
programs.description: Large-scale native sapling plantation drives. Banyan, Peepal, Jamun across rural pathways, schools, farmlands, and community commons to enrich soil & groundwater.
programs.highlight: Planting for Ecological Growth • 100+ 2.5 Lakh planted

programs.title: Apartment & Office Landscaping
programs.description: Balcony gardens, terrace greenery, corporate indoor landscaping, vertical living walls, and scheduled organic plant care for modern residential and commercial offices.
programs.highlight: Custom green designs • Professional maintenance teams

programs.title: Real Herbal Nursery & Organic Saplings
programs.description: Cultivation of authentic medicinal plants (Tulsi, Ashwagandha, Lemongrass, Amla) along with Miyawaki mini-forest development educating caretakers and botanical curiosity.
programs.highlight: Heirloom native saplings • Organic compost & soil blend
